en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a bustling European city square with tram tracks, horse-drawn carriages, street vendors with market stalls, and pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. Multi‑story historic buildings with shops line both sides of the square. A decorative street lamp stands in the foreground and there is a statue on a pedestal to the left. The printed caption at the top reads in red 'GRAZ' and 'Hauptplatz'. Faint handwritten notes in German are visible across the sky area and bottom margin.
